title: Connect owner-authorized read-only search evidence to Space coaching
detail: Connects bounded Google and Bing readers to private encrypted credentials, one-use OAuth state/PKCE and revision/generation CAS, fresh direct-editor and purpose-consent gates, property verification, owner connection/forget controls and on-demand evidence coaching. Google queries only approved exact pages; Bing requires dedicated verified published custom-domain property. No raw queries, generated user copy, provider writes, background ingestion or credential UI. New service-role-only RLS table migration25300 requires disposable full database CI and canonical apply before use. Source/mocked tests do not establish provider account acceptance, configured secrets, live grants or production release. LIVE-1335 broader acceptance remains open. See RUNBOOKS Connected search evidence for callback/setup, key rotation and rollback procedures. Diagnostic acceptance follow-up: callback distinguishes missing, malformed/duplicate and rejected state using fixed local outcomes, displays safe notices on the operator hub/coach page, and never exchanges without exact valid consumed state. No raw provider error/code/state values are rendered or logged. Focused offline/rendered verification only; Bing live account acceptance remains incomplete until the provider redirect is diagnosed and a real authorized review succeeds.

verify.note: Executes actual encrypted state and runtime access gates offline with inert dependencies; tests separate database/provider/UI boundaries without contacting services.
